Vi|jgl.identity: Physical damage fighter who specializes in ganking and locking down a target. Vault Breaker (Q) charges up, then dashes her forward, knocking back the first target, Denting Blows (W) shreds armor and deals percent-health damage every three attacks, Relentless Force (E) strikes in a cone through the target, and Cease and Desist (R) sends her charging, unstoppable, at a chosen champion to knock them up. Her passive gives her a shield when she hits an ability.
Vi|jgl.playstyle: Simple, effective gank and engage jungler: her ultimate locks down a target with no way to stop it.
Vi|jgl.early_game: Clear with W and E. Gank from level 3: charged Q to knock the target toward your laner, then attacks and E. Keep Q to go through a wall or escape.
Vi|jgl.level_2: Relentless Force (E). Strikes in a cone: your clear speeds up.
Vi|jgl.level_3: Vault Breaker (Q). First gank: charged Q → knock back the target → attacks (W) → E. Q is maxed first.
Vi|jgl.level_6: Cease and Desist: she charges, unstoppable, at a chosen champion and knocks them up. Ideal to lock down a carry in teamfights or a fleeing target in ganks.
power_spikes: Level 6: unstoppable lockdown with your ultimate.
First completed item: strong ganks and dives.
Vi|jgl.jungle_plan: Safe clear and ganks from level 3. Vi wins through ganks and dives: control Scuttles, gank lanes where the target has no escape, and take Void Grubs (around 8 minutes) and dragons with your team. After 6, nearly every gank is guaranteed.
Vi|jgl.trading: Ganking: charged Q → attacks → E. Teamfighting: R on the enemy carry → Q → attacks. Give up on it against junglers who beat you in duels (Wukong) or lock you down (Zyra).
threats: Zyra and Karthus, unfavorable according to the data.
Casting your ultimate without follow-up from your team.
mistakes: Charging Q for too long (the target walks away).
Casting your ultimate on a tank instead of a carry.
Diving when your team can't follow.

matchup_notes.Lee Sin: Gank faster than him and avoid his invades.
matchup_notes.Graves: He beats you in duels: gank where he isn't.
matchup_notes.Sylas: He can steal your ultimate: don't engage when he can take it back.
matchup_notes.Wukong: His clone fools you: aim your ultimate at the real one.
matchup_notes.Viego: Lock him down with your ultimate when he dives.

Vi|jgl.mid_game: Ganks and engages on carries around objectives.
Vi|jgl.late_game: Ultimate on the enemy carry, then Q and attacks. Wait until your team can follow.
Vi|jgl.ahead: Gank nonstop, dive and take objectives.
Vi|jgl.behind: Look for picks with your ultimate and play with your team.
Vi|jgl.win_condition: To win this game, you want to create advantages through ganks and lock down the enemy carry in teamfights.
Vi|jgl.final_tip: Save your ultimate for the enemy carry: it's an unstoppable charge, nobody can stop it.
